text:
A plane mirror is on a wall.
Which is a correct description of the image formed by the mirror?
A
the right way up and smaller than the object
B
the right way up and the same size as the object
C
upside down and smaller than the object
D
upside down and the same size as the object

options.label: A
options.text: the right way up and smaller than the object

options.label: B
options.text: the right way up and the same size as the object

options.label: C
options.text: upside down and smaller than the object

options.label: D
options.text: upside down and the same size as the object
